basic_details.short_information: Here are the key details of the DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 at a glance:

important_dates.application_start_date: Not specified in the official notification

qualification.details: Eligibility for the DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 depends on the specific post applied for, and is based on a combination of educational qualification, post-qualification experience, and age limit, detailed below. | In addition to formal qualifications, candidates must have relevant experience in at least one of the following areas: innovation and entrepreneurship, business development or strategic partnerships, program management, grant management, consulting/collaboration/partner management/HR, communications and outreach, design and implementation of challenges or hackathons, product management, IT operations, project management or product development (in a start-up or manufacturing industry), or finance/estimation/accounting. | Age relaxation details are not specified in the official notification.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be engaged as Individual Consultants and paid a consolidated monthly consultancy fee, inclusive of all taxes, as decided by the competent authority based on the recommendation of the Interview & Selection Committee. | The individual consultant is liable to pay Goods and Services Tax (GST) as applicable, though provision exists for reimbursement of GST paid against the consultancy fee received. An annual increment of up to 10% of the existing consultancy fee may be given based on annual appraisal, as per DIO rules. However, during any extension period or at the time of annual increment, the monthly consultancy fee cannot exceed 1.80 times the initial monthly fee.

selection_process: Candidates shortlisted from the applications received will be notified about the interview by email. Shortlisted candidates may be called for an in-person interview at New Delhi
or through Video Conferencing. The interview process may involve:
Skill tests Personal interview Group discussions
DIO will not entertain any queries regarding fare reimbursement or travel expenses for attending the interview.
how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates can apply for the DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 by following these steps:
Go to the "Career" section on the website.
Locate the DIO Individual Consultant (Project Management Team) advertisement.
Fill in the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and experience details.
Upload the required documents as a single PDF file, within the prescribed file size.
Submit the application online before 5:00 PM on 10 August 2026.

Applications are accepted only through the online mode. Applications received through any other mode will not be considered, and any deviation from the prescribed submission method (including file size limits) may result in immediate disqualification.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a contract basis and does not confer any right to permanent absorption or regular engagement in DIO. The place of work is New Delhi; however, the consultant may be deputed to other locations as per DIO's requirements during the engagement period. Individual Consultants must not be engaged directly or indirectly in any other trade, business, occupation, or remunerative commitment while working full-time with DIO. Engagement is subject to acceptance of a Consultancy Contract (Undertaking/Bond) executed on a stamp paper of ₹200. Any extension of the contract after joining will be up to the date the consultant attains 60 years of age, whichever is earlier. Applicable Income Tax or other statutory deductions will be made at source before consultancy payments, and DIO will issue a TDS certificate. DIO reserves the right to terminate the hiring process or contract at any time without assigning any reason, and to increase, decrease, or not fill any of the advertised positions. DIO will not entertain queries regarding the hiring process, nor is it obligated to explain its hiring decisions to applicants. For further details or clarification, candidates may email [email protected]

content_sections.heading: DIO Individual Consultant Vacancy 2026: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: The vacancy break-up for the DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 is as follows: Category-wise reservation breakup is not specified in the official notification, as this is a contract-based consultancy engagement rather than a regular reserved-category recruitment.

content_sections.heading: DIO Individual Consultant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for the DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026 depends on the specific post applied for, and is based on a combination of educational qualification, post-qualification experience, and age limit, detailed below. In addition to formal qualifications, candidates must have relevant experience in at least one of the following areas: innovation and entrepreneurship, business development or strategic partnerships, program management, grant management, consulting/collaboration/partner management/HR, communications and outreach, design and implementation of challenges or hackathons, product management, IT operations, project management or product development (in a start-up or manufacturing industry), or finance/estimation/accounting. Age relaxation details are not specified in the official notification.

rows.educational_qualification_experience: Master's Degree in Science/Management/Technology or equivalent with 10 years of post-qualification experience in the relevant field; OR Bachelor's Degree in the same fields with 12 years of post-qualification experience
Master's Degree in Science/Management/Technology or equivalent with 6 years of post-qualification experience; OR Bachelor's Degree in the same fields with 8 years of post-qualification experience
Master's Degree in Science/Management/Technology or equivalent with 2 years of post-qualification experience; OR Bachelor's Degree in the same fields with 4 years of post-qualification experience
Master's Degree in Science/Management/Technology or equivalent (no post-qualification experience required); OR Bachelor's Degree in the same fields with 1 year of post-qualification experience

content_sections.heading: DIO Individual Consultant Salary (Consultancy Fee)
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be engaged as Individual Consultants and paid a consolidated monthly consultancy fee, inclusive of all taxes, as decided by the competent authority based on the recommendation of the Interview & Selection Committee. The individual consultant is liable to pay Goods and Services Tax (GST) as applicable, though provision exists for reimbursement of GST paid against the consultancy fee received. An annual increment of up to 10% of the existing consultancy fee may be given based on annual appraisal, as per DIO rules. However, during any extension period or at the time of annual increment, the monthly consultancy fee cannot exceed 1.80 times the initial monthly fee.

content_sections.heading: DIO Individual Consultant Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted from the applications received will be notified about the interview by email. Shortlisted candidates may be called for an in-person interview at New Delhi, or through Video Conferencing. The interview process may involve: Skill tests Personal interview Group discussions, debates, and/or quizzes DIO will not entertain any queries regarding fare reimbursement or travel expenses for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents
content_sections.text: The notification specifies that applicants must upload the required documents in a single PDF file (within the prescribed size limit) wherever mentioned in the online application form. A detailed itemized list of documents is not specified in the official notification; candidates should refer to the application form on www.idex.gov.in for the exact document requirements.

faq.question: Q1. What is DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Defence Innovation Organisation (DIO) to hire Individual Consultants on contract basis for four roles — Program Director, Deputy Program Director, Program Executive, and Deputy Program Executive — for its iDEX Project Management Team.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 positions are available: 2 Program Director, 1 Deputy Program Director, 2 Program Executive, and 1 Deputy Program Executive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 10 August 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for DIO Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post, ranging from a Bachelor's Degree with relevant experience (for Deputy Program Executive) to a Master's or Bachelor's Degree with up to 12 years of post-qualification experience (for Program Director). See the qualification table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age as on 10 August 2026 is below 55 years for Program Director, below 40 years for Deputy Program Director, below 30 years for Program Executive, and below 26 years for Deputy Program Executive.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Career section of www.idex.gov.in before 5:00 PM on 10 August 2026. Applications through any other mode will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for DIO Individual Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email and called for an in-person interview at New Delhi or via Video Conferencing, which may include skill tests, personal interview, and group discussions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for DIO Individual Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Selected consultants receive a monthly consultancy fee ranging from ₹40,000 (Deputy Program Executive) up to ₹2,40,000 (Program Director), depending on the post, inclusive of all taxes.
